title: Similar - R2R Horizon and Cost Sweep
goal: Evaluate multiple MPC horizon and Q/R settings on a six-state web-line surrogate and pick the best tradeoff between tracking quality, overshoot, settling, and control effort.
skillBenefitRationale: The task requires selecting horizon N and balancing Q/R weights to trade off response speed, overshoot, and actuator effort in a web-tension-like setting.
